The onelegged sailor's course as inferred from

  the presbytery where Father Conmee lives (3), MacConnell's
  pharmacy (4), the Blooms' house (5), and 14 Nelson Street (6). 
  Source: Gunn and Hart, James Joyce's Dublin.
